snippet.title: Frosted Love - A Phase Invaders Visual Novel PV
snippet.description:
❄️ AVAILABLE NOW ❄️

A short free visual novel project where you play as an unnamed protagonist who has the opportunity to take one of four Phase Invaders on a Christmas Date.

Game and Free Desktop Wallpapers Available on: dizzydokuro.itch.io/frosted-love

PV Credit: Dog

& Special Thank you to Phase Connect for making this project possible.
